# Bilingual Buddies

> Bilingual English-Spanish printable activity packs and storybooks for kids ages 3-7.

## Pages

- [Bilingual Buddies](https://ndflores190.github.io/bilingualbuddies/): Printable bilingual activity packs, coloring, tracing, counting, and vocabulary worksheets, plus Loky the Beagle picture books. Instant PDF downloads on Gumroad and paperbacks on Amazon.
